source_evidence: Exact player 'Present evidence' delegates presentation of relevant historical evidence to Voss, not surrender or unrelated confidential disclosures. Cirren presents his actual working copies of Silverward's in-place Vaishnavi dedication, upkeep/refuge/protection charter and engraved route instrument's station reference from D331 lower archive comparison. Originals remain at Silverward, portable leaves/coffer and Mara's authenticated survey remain in Mara's custody outside, no original surrendered or exact directions/location, heart, private ancestry or unrelated evidence disclosed. Voss summons existing western customs oath-book from upstairs archive (existing Spy brings it to ground receiving room and returns to archive), allows supervised examination and comparison of relevant historical entry and later endorsements. Ordinary legible document comparison follows fixed dm-estate-ancestry.md @f4b7f371448c8ef2d2b5f3c3467ac843b8b0f291 and ashen-regency-field-operations-dm-only.md @6b58329ad8c128c24fd903edbfa0234362505e3c; no roll or gatekeeping. Voss acknowledges matching institutional reference and historical derivation of station authority from Vaishnavi, Cirren identifies original protection/refuge/upkeep obligation and limitation on service demands without protection; later claimed rights do not establish current title or supersede present Crown law, and historical institutional continuity does not establish identical masonry or V's personal genealogy. Voss admits old obligations qualify inherited rights, but disputes that historical connection alone conveys current possession; asks V what settlement he seeks. No current tenant exemption original or seizure tallies inspected, no modern charter validated, no title/territory conceded, handover, suspension of general tolls, quest reward, combat or payment. Voss has learned relevant historical inscription contents and their match to his oath-book, not exact Silverward location, heart or private lineage. Book remains in his custody on desk, Cirren retains copies, no copies left behind. Fixed roster unchanged, Mara with coach, V/Cirren/Fenar in receiving room. Approximately D33315:46–16:00, ordinary inspection ~10min and conversation. V chooses next demand/action.
